In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fuzzy control is a viable alternative to crisp and can be a useful addition to a control strategy when the system has limited control opportunities and the response delay is small.
fuzzy is a viable alternative to crisp control, particularly in situations where the system response to a change in control actions is delayed and the control opportunities are restricted.
fuzzy control is not necessarily superior to crisp control in all situations and fuzzy control is not a panacea for all control problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
fuzzy control can be an effective tool for production systems if the control opportunities are not too few and the response delay is not too large.
fuzzy control is an efficient control strategy when control opportunities are plentiful and the response is immediate.
fuzzy control is a viable alternative to conventional control in situations where the system response is delayed and the control opportunities are restricted.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of fuzzy control is sensitive to the system response and the control opportunities.
fuzzy control is not a panacea for all problems and its utility is seriously restricted by the control opportunities and response delays in the system.
the utility of fuzzy is not universal.
